name: Desk Reset — 14 Days
description: Two weeks of short, targeted mobility for a body that sits too much: 8–15 minutes a day undoing the neck, shoulders, hips, and back that a desk (and a long hyperfocus session) locks up. Movement snacks, easy days, and — at the end — the two routines that actually helped, set to repeat so the reset sticks.

0.title: Set two phone reminders to stand up every 90 minutes
Quick body scan — where are you tight? Neck, back, or hips?

2.title: 10 min hip openers — you fold these up all day

6.title: Easy day: 5 min box breathing + a short walk

8.title: 12 min hips + glute activation — the real anti-sitting fix

9.title: 10 min low-back care — cat/cow and gentle rotation

12.title: Walk 15 min outside. That's the whole task.

13.title: Pick the 2 routines that helped most and set them to repeat daily
Note what changed — neck? hips? back?
